modules.blurb: Set expectations and demystify AI before doing anything.

lessons.blurb: Memory (the context window), context, images, and the limits of what it knows.

lessons.blurb: Hallucination, bias, the "tells," and the habit of verifying.

lessons.blurb: Ownership, copyright, fair use, and responsible, audience-aware use.

lessons.title: Your Data Isn't Private
lessons.blurb: Privacy, permissions, and what not to feed AI.

lessons.title: Who Wins With AI?
lessons.blurb: AI as a tool — domain expertise and clear intent win.

modules.blurb: Build repeatable systems instead of one-off outputs.

lessons.title: Build Systems, Not Outputs
lessons.blurb: Don't ask AI for the finished thing — build the system that makes it.

lessons.title: Organize Your Work
lessons.blurb: Folders, information architecture, a project log, and a sandbox.

lessons.title: Git & GitHub Basics
lessons.blurb: Track and share your work with version control.

lessons.title: The Production Pipeline
lessons.blurb: Chain small steps with human checkpoints to produce a finished whole.
